title: The Three Rocks of Glory Set in the Outer Worlds
description: From a single appointment by the Greatness, three confirmed truths in ultimates are set into the outer worlds: the Pillar of Glory / Perfect Man (bearing-up), the new Land of Light pressed down upon the Land of Darkness (subduing), and the great Thought that is Jesus the Radiance (awakening Call). Together they form the threefold foundation by which the redemptive economy stands fast.
